eligible_deposits: Eligible depositors of a licensed deposit taker; compensation of up to $100,000 per deposit taker on the failure of a deposit taker. The source memo does not itemise every eligibility exclusion; the Deposit Takers Act 2023 (Part 6) governs the scheme.
eligible_institutions: Licensed deposit takers under the Deposit Takers Act 2023
status: In force and operational from 1 July 2025; administered by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand; funded by levies paid by deposit takers
notes: Cap is per depositor per deposit taker (not per bank group / not a government guarantee of all deposits). Briefing is the Reserve Bank final implementation briefing to the Minister of Finance prior to 1 July 2025 commencement.
